system.description: As part of casting a jutsu with the Barrier keyword, you weave a potent acid into the threads of chakra that form your shield. Creatures that deal damage as a result of a melee attack to this Barrier must make a Constitution saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Deteriorate for each successful attack against it. This saving throw is made at the end of the current turn.
